d_2=89-10d_3
\]

\[

\]
\[
d_3=8 \Rightarrow d_2=9 \quad \text{valid}
\]
\[
d_3=9 \Rightarrow d_2=-1 \text{ invalid}
\]

Candidate number: \(198\). Verify:

\[
1+9+8=18,\quad 11\cdot 18=198
\]

Also, \(89d_1=d_2+10d_3\le 99\), so \(d_1=1\) only.

\[
\boxed{198}
\]
